description.ja: ・ 一部パーツの差し替えで、収納形態の再現が可能。

description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decals are included! “Hyaku” for the main unit is also included!

description.ja: メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー用のコーションマーク等の他、百式本体用の“百”のマーキングも水転写デカールで収録。
description.en: In addition to the caution marks for the Mega Bazooka Launcher, the "Hyaku" marking for the Hyakushiki body is also included as a water transfer decal.
